decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P -08SLG-01, P -08SLG-02
amended plans received: 23/07/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used as a gym and store incidental to the use of 8 St Leonards Gardens as a single family hose or other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 8 St Leonards Gardens, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen, bedroom(s), bath or shower be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as gym, games room and garage .
